title: Search-Guided Reasoning Trace Curation for Verilog Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation. However, most training pipelines distill natural-language reasoning traces whose intermediate design decisions are weakly structured and are primarily selected according to the correctness of the final generated RTL. We present MCTS-SFT, a verifier-guided framework for curating reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of Verilog generation models. MCTS-SFT formulates trace construction as search over intermediate reasoning states and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to propagate functional feedback from complete Verilog rollouts to earlier design decisions. Within this framework, we introduce Plan-MCTS, which searches over compact hardware-design plans that explicitly represent interfaces, timing, state, behavior, and update rules. translated_title: 面向 Verilog 生成的搜索引导式推理轨迹筛选
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展提升了 Verilog 代码生成的水平。然而，大多数训练流程所蒸馏的自然语言推理轨迹中，中间设计决策的结构化程度较弱，且主要依据最终生成的 RTL 的正确性来进行筛选。我们提出了 MCTS-SFT，这是一个由验证器引导的框架，用于为 Verilog 生成模型的监督微调（SFT）筛选推理轨迹。MCTS-SFT 将轨迹构建表述为在中间推理状态上的搜索，并利用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）将来自完整 Verilog 展开结果的功能反馈传播到较早的设计决策上。在该框架内，我们引入了 Plan-MCTS，它在紧凑的硬件设计计划上进行搜索，这些计划显式地表示接口、时序、状态、行为和更新规则。我们进一步研究了计划保持式监督，其中搜索得到的结构化状态被保留作为……
tldr: 该论文提出 MCTS-SFT 框架，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）将完整 Verilog 生成的功能验证反馈传播到早期设计决策，从而筛选出结构化的硬件设计计划推理轨迹，用于监督微调 Verilog 生成模型。
en_tdlr: MCTS-SFT is a verifier-guided framework that uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to propagate functional feedback from complete Verilog rollouts back to earlier design decisions, curating structured hardware-design plan reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning of Verilog generation models.
